sources.name: Real-time flood-monitoring API reference
sources.geography: England and Wales monitoring stations, flood areas, warnings and alerts
sources.usage_limit: Near-real-time conditions and warning areas are not parcel-specific flood probabilities; timestamps and station/area identifiers must be retained.

sources.name: Historic Flood Warnings
sources.geography: England; historic alert and warning records
sources.usage_limit: Warning issuance history is not the same as observed inundation or parcel damage and requires exact warning-area/time joins.

sources.name: Flood risk postcode search tool data
sources.usage_limit: Risk describes the area around an address, not the address or parcel itself; not suitable for current-event warnings.

sources.name: Risk of Flooding from Surface Water
sources.geography: England modelled surface-water extents, depths and likelihood bands
sources.usage_limit: Probabilistic national/local modelling requires exact geometry, scale and version checks; it is not evidence that a specific parcel has flooded.

sources.name: Risk of Flooding from Rivers and Sea
sources.geography: England modelled river and sea flood-risk areas
sources.usage_limit: Defences reduce but do not remove risk; area risk cannot be promoted to a parcel without exact spatial/version evidence.

sources.name: Risk of Flooding from Rivers and Sea - Climate Change
sources.geography: England future river and sea flood-risk scenarios
sources.usage_limit: Scenario outputs are not present-day observations and require scenario, horizon and defence assumptions to be retained.

sources.name: Real-time Flood Data River Levels
sources.geography: Monitoring stations in England, with some Wales records
sources.usage_limit: A station reading is not a parcel water level; station identity, distance, catchment and timestamp must be preserved.

sources.name: Risk of Flooding from Rivers and Sea - Properties in Areas at Risk
sources.geography: England areas at risk linked through Ordnance Survey references
sources.usage_limit: The publisher states outputs are generally unsuitable for property-level assessment; floor level and depth evidence are absent.

sources.publisher: UK Health Security Agency / Met Office
sources.name: Weather-Health Alerting System
sources.usage_limit: Regional health alerts are response-context indicators, not parcel weather measurements or crime/security scores.

sources.name: Weather-health alert system user guide
sources.usage_limit: Methodology and responder guidance only; alerts require region and active-time matching.

sources.publisher: UK Health Security Agency / Met Office
sources.name: Heat health alerts dashboard
sources.usage_limit: Regional heat-health impact alerts are not site temperature observations and should expire with their stated alert period.

sources.publisher: UK Health Security Agency / Met Office
sources.name: Cold health alerts dashboard
sources.usage_limit: Regional cold-health alerts are seasonal and time-bounded; they are not parcel observations.
